lots.title: Stockport Town Centre School — Multi-Disciplinary Design Team Appointment
lots.description: Single undivided lot covering the appointment of a multi-disciplinary design team for the Stockport Town Centre School. The document in scope is the Stage 1 Procurement Specific Questionnaire (PSQ) Response template under contract reference 020417, let via a Competitive Flexible Procedure. The detailed Scope of Services for each discipline is not included in this document; the questionnaire text expressly defers evaluation against the technical scope to the separately referenced 'Specification (Document 2)'. The Stage 1 preliminary question asking 'Please confirm which lot(s) you wish to bid for' is answered 'N/A', which confirms the undivided single-lot structure already recorded in the notice. The appointment spans five discipline roles referred to in the Stage 1 Workforce and Resources question: Architecture, M&E, Structures & Civils, Building Regulations Principal Designer (BR PD under the Building Safety Act 2022), and CDM Principal Designer (CDM PD under CDM 2015).
requirements: Procedure: Competitive Flexible Procedure under the Procurement Act 2023 (contract reference 020417).

Bidder must be registered on the Central Digital Platform (CDP) and provide a unique CDP identifier together with Core Supplier Information, connected person information, and exclusion grounds information.
Bidder must not appear on the Debarment List (Cabinet Office / gov.uk debarment register).
Minimum insurance cover (held or committed to obtain prior to award): Employer's (Compulsory) Liability £10m, Public Liability £10m, Professional Indemnity £20m.
Financial capacity assessed via Core Supplier Information plus a Company Watch Credit Report; a credit score of 24 or below triggers further due diligence and may result in exclusion.

UK GDPR compliance: technical and organisational measures for confidentiality, integrity, availability, data subject rights, cross-border safeguards, and records of processing activities must be in place by contract award.
30-day payment terms must be included in all onward supply chain contracts for public sector contracts awarded under the Procurement Act 2023.
Published 2050 net zero plan on the bidder's website.
Carbon Reduction Plan (Q27) via the linked Microsoft Forms submission (failure to complete may result in rejection).
Modern Slavery Act 2015 Section 54 compliance and assurance covering structure/supply chain, policies, due diligence, risk assessment, effectiveness measurement, and staff training.
Real Living Wage (RLW): commitment to pay RLW (as set by the Living Wage Foundation) to employees and sub-contractor personnel working 2+ hours per week for 8 consecutive weeks on the contract.

Health and safety: SSIP accreditation within the last 12 months is required; absence requires full completion of the questions (c)-(k) on H&S arrangements. No unresolved HSE enforcement or remedial orders in the last 3 years without satisfactory remediation.
Written and dated Health and Safety Policy reviewed regularly; access to competent H&S advice per the Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations.
RIDDOR-compliant accident reporting and investigation arrangements with three-year accident history disclosure.

Adherence to the STAR Responsible Procurement Strategy Core and Additional Expectations (Annex 1) and to Article 4 of the European Convention on Human Rights regarding prohibition of slavery and forced labour.
Associated persons and sub-contractors must be declared (Part 2A/2B), CDP-registered where applicable, and none may appear on the Debarment List.
Supplier must self-declare, via Part 3 Confirmations, that answers are complete, accurate and not misleading and that supplementary information will be provided on request.

warnings.message: This document is the Stage 1 Procurement Specific Questionnaire (PSQ) response template ('3-Response-Document') under the Competitive Flexible Procedure. It defines Stage 1 selection criteria (scored Technical Ability + pass/fail checks) but does not contain the technical scope of services; the text expressly refers to a separate 'Specification (Document 2)' that is not included here.

Discipline-specific scope of services (Appendix A referenced by the pre-existing notice-level lot description) is not present in this document. Lot requirements captured here are limited to what the Stage 1 questionnaire explicitly states about team composition and evaluation themes.

No CPV codes appear anywhere in the source markdown. The notice-level 'main_category' field in the parent record ('150000 - Consultancy') is a ProContract taxonomy code and must not be treated as a CPV reference. No CPV codes are asserted by this extraction.

Procurement is professional design services only (Architect, MEP, Structures & Civils, BR PD, CDM PD). There are no goods or material products to seed; product_requirements and product_requirement_seeds are intentionally empty.

The Part 1 preliminary question 'Please confirm which lot(s) you wish to bid for?' is answered 'N/A', confirming the undivided single-lot structure already recorded in the notice. The existing synthetic single lot is retained.
Docling output reports page_count = 0 and contains no explicit page breaks; evidence anchors use markdown line numbers (md:line-N) as page_ref instead of native page numbers.
No tender submission deadline, RIBA stage milestone dates, or contract start dates are present in this document. Key dates were not extracted.
